data.long_meaning: Haardika is a Sanskrit and Hindu name derived from the root word 'haard' meaning fearless or valiant. It is a strong name that signifies courage and bravery. The name Haardika carries the meaning “Fearless, Valiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Haardika usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless, valiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
